decisions.reason: The same source message separately establishes the Small Block cadence, qualifying sale types, and ongoing pool funding, and those effects are already fully represented by its message-143 MODIFY.
The FAQ was introduced by the same message with the current Big Block amount, approximate sales cadence, qualifying sale types, and ongoing pool-funding explanation already encoded.
The candidate's message-143 MODIFY already records that secondary-sale royalties fund the prize pools on an ongoing basis; the Big Block change requires no additional royalty-state update.

Changing the Big Block draw cadence and recognizing secondary sales as qualifying sales does not change ticket issuance: the source still limits ticket awards to successful referred mints, consistent with the candidate state.
The candidate's existing message-143 MODIFY already records ongoing primary-sale funding of both Small and Big Block pools, so no additional allocation change is needed.
The Big Block draw cadence and funding changes do not alter the independently defined Small Block ticket issuance, eligibility, or reset behavior.
The source changes Big Block draw cadence and funding semantics but leaves Chainlink VRF selection, on-chain execution, fairness, and verification unchanged.
Counting secondary sales toward prize draws and pool funding does not change which NFT state transfers to a secondary buyer.
The Big Block prize change does not alter the NFT ebook asset type, unlimited supply model, mint price, or mint-number identifier.
The source retains the existing Winners-page one-click claim flow; draw cadence and pool-funding changes do not modify payout behavior.
Big Block remains active and continues using tickets, so the Big Block ticket counter remains valid; the changed draw cadence and funding rules do not require a metadata attribute change.
The Big Block draw and pool-funding changes do not affect the Transak provider, supported payment methods, or wallet and crypto requirements.
